adjustments.reason: Revenue on multi-year freight contracts recognised at contract signature rather than over the performance period; reversed on restatement of FY2025.

expected_assessment.rationale: As certified on 13 May 2026: 220.0 / 34.0 = 6.47059 -> 6.47x vs the 6.50x ceiling; 0.03x headroom. Adjusted EBITDA 34.0 = 29.5 + 3.2 + 1.0 + 0.3, every add-back still unadjudicated (allowed = null). PASS — this is the GREEN the certificate asserts and the demo starts from.
As certified: 34.0 / 16.5 = 2.06061 -> 2.06x vs the 2.00x floor; 0.06x headroom. PASS.

Restated 3 Jul 2026: Adjusted EBITDA recomputes to 29.5 - 1.7 (IFRS 15 revenue reversal) + 0.2 (only realised synergy) + 1.0 (exceptional) + 0.0 (transaction fees disallowed) = 29.0. Net debt never moved (220.0). 220.0 / 29.0 = 7.58621 -> 7.59x vs the 6.50x ceiling -> BREACH by 1.09x. audited_restated outranks borrower_certified in basis_precedence, so this supersedes the 6.47x PASS: certification conflict (certificate says IN_COMPLIANCE). memory_hit: run_rate_synergy disallowed under sponsor ardenmoor matches the Halveston pattern. No field-map drift — the fingerprint is unchanged; only the values were restated.

Restated: 29.0 / 16.5 = 1.75758 -> 1.76x vs the 2.00x floor -> BREACH by 0.24x. Cash interest is unchanged at 16.5 on both vintages; the entire move comes from the EBITDA restatement. memory_hit is recorded once, on the leverage covenant, so the scoreboard counts one retrieval.

notes:
SYNTHETIC fixture — every entity is invented (Thornwick Logistics Holdings plc, Ardenmoor Capital Partners LLP, Cheswick Bank plc, Larkfield Downe LLP, Marbury Tolland LLP, Peverell Freight, and all named signatories). No real company, fund, or person. All amounts GBP millions.

MECHANISM: restatement over time — the headline money-shot. One test date (31 Mar 2026) carries two observations of the same quarter on different bases, and the flip is pure basis_precedence resolution (audited_restated > borrower_certified), not a special case.

ARITHMETIC (every ratio reproducible from the measures; rounding half_up to 2 dp):
  q4-2025 (borrower_certified, as_of 2026-02-12) — baseline:
    Adjusted EBITDA  = 33.2 (Consolidated EBITDA) + 1.0 (exceptional) = 34.2
    Leverage         = 217.0 / 34.2 = 6.345029... -> 6.35x  vs 6.50x ceiling -> PASS
    Interest cover   = 34.2 / 16.3  = 2.098159... -> 2.10x  vs 2.00x floor   -> PASS
  q1-2026 (borrower_certified, as_of 2026-05-13) — the certificate:
    Adjusted EBITDA  = 29.5 + 3.2 (synergies) + 1.0 (exceptional) + 0.3 (transaction) = 34.0
    Leverage         = 220.0 / 34.0 = 6.470588... -> 6.47x  vs 6.50x ceiling -> PASS
    Interest cover   = 34.0 / 16.5  = 2.060606... -> 2.06x  vs 2.00x floor   -> PASS
  q1-2026 (audited_restated, as_of 2026-07-03) — the recompute:
    Consolidated EBITDA = 29.5 - 1.7 (IFRS 15 revenue reversal) = 27.8
    Adjusted EBITDA  = 29.5 + (0.2 + 1.0 + 0.0 allowed add-backs) + (-1.7) = 29.0
    Leverage         = 220.0 / 29.0 = 7.586206... -> 7.59x  vs 6.50x ceiling -> BREACH
    Interest cover   = 29.0 / 16.5  = 1.757575... -> 1.76x  vs 2.00x floor   -> BREACH
  Net debt is 220.0 on BOTH q1-2026 vintages — the entire move is EBITDA 34.0 -> 29.0.

EBITDA BRIDGE CONVENTION: ebitda_build.base_amount on the restated observation is 29.5, the Consolidated EBITDA as originally certified; the signed revenue_reversal adjustment (-1.7) restates it to the 27.8 recorded in measures[]. The kernel's recompute (base + sum(allowed add-backs) + sum(adjustments)) therefore reproduces 29.0 in one sum. On the certified observation every add-back has allowed=null (claimed, not yet adjudicated); the audit sets allowed=false on the synergy and the transaction fees. add_back_ids are deliberately shared across the two q1-2026 observations so the certified-vs-restated adjudication diff joins on add_back_id.

SYNERGY CAP, RECOMPUTED NOT TRUSTED: pre-synergy Adjusted EBITDA = 34.0 - 3.2 = 30.8; 20% cap = 6.16; claimed 3.2 <= 6.16 so within_cap = true. The 20% cap is therefore NOT the binding test. The limb requires synergies to be BOTH within the cap AND realised in the Relevant Period; only 0.2 was realised, so 3.0 is disallowed with disallowed_reason='not_realised_in_window'. (The brief described this as 'cap + not realised'; both tests are represented in the data, but on these numbers no 20% cap can bite on a 3.2 add-back against ~30x EBITDA, so the arithmetically supportable reason is non-realisation. Flagged rather than silently fudged.) The 0.3 transaction advisory fee is disallowed as 'outside_definition' — fees on an aborted acquisition fall outside limb (d).

NO SCHEMA DRIFT: field_map_fingerprint is identical across all three observations (sha256 over newline-joined sorted 'canonical_key:raw_name' pairs, same algorithm as the sibling fixtures). Same field map, different values = restatement. That is the deliberate contrast with Northgate, where the values hold still and the field map moves. unmapped_fields is empty everywhere.

NARRATIVE THE NUMBERS CARRY: underlying Consolidated EBITDA actually FELL 33.2 -> 29.5 between the two quarters while headline Adjusted EBITDA held flat at 34.2 -> 34.0, because the borrower introduced a new 3.2 run-rate synergy add-back at q1-2026 (first_claimed_period_id='q1-2026'). The deterioration was masked by the add-back; the audit removes the mask.

watch_rule IS DELIBERATELY null ON BOTH COVENANTS. The certified 6.47x sits 0.03x under the ceiling, so any realistic proximity band (the sibling fixtures use headroom_absolute 0.25) would classify it WATCH and pre-empt the flip. The demo and the brief both require the certificate to read GREEN/PASS and the recompute to read BREACH, so Thornwick carries no watch band; WATCH is Borrower B's mechanism (trend-driven).

SCOPE NOTE: the FY2025 restatement is dated 3 Jul 2026 and logically also touches the 31 Dec 2025 test date, but q4-2025 deliberately carries ONLY the pre-restatement borrower_certified vintage. It exists to establish the 'was green' baseline; no audited_restated observation is supplied for it, so the kernel resolves q4-2025 on borrower_certified and returns PASS. A full restatement cascade onto q4-2025 is out of scope.

There is no real underlying file, so it hashes a declared string rather than pretending to hash a document. events[] holds one SYNTHETIC placeholder with retrieved_via='manual' and a non-resolving URL — nothing was crawled to build this fixture; the live REAL You.com ARI result replaces it at runtime. expected_assessment[] is a test oracle only and must never be read by assess().
